title: delphinium elatum subsp. bosniacum
intro: Delphinium elatum subsp. bosniacum, commonly known as the Balkan delphinium, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the family Ranunculaceae. It is a perennial plant native to the Balkan region, known for its tall spikes of blue or white flowers. The Balkan delphinium has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including delphinidin, quercetin, and kaempferol, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as relaxing muscles, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress.
